hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Adabe [adb], an alleged Papuan language of Atauro island, does not exist and it has been explained how it was mistakenly thought to exist (**hh:hb:Hull:ETimor**:3-4) viz.~a misreading of an ambiguous statement by a missionary that made it into **hh:h:WurmHattori:Pacific** from where the E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 entry derives from (**hh:hv:Hull:Timor**:41).
